prompts.title: Resting on the Leaning Branch
prompts.prompt:
Style: Cinematic autumn forest photography, dreamy, serene mood, warm golden sunbeams, peaceful nature portrait. Vertical 4:5 or 3:4 aspect ratio.

Setting: Quiet forest with tall trees, golden and amber autumn foliage, soft mist hanging in the air. A thick, curved tree branch with rough-textured bark, where the man rests. Sunlight filters through the canopy, creating visible light rays.

Subject: uploaded man with neatly styled hair, relaxed, peaceful expression, eyes closed or gazing upward. Wearing a classic plaid cotton shirt, dark denim trousers, and casual sneakers. Lying comfortably on the large branch, back supported, legs bent loosely, hands clasped gently over his stomach.

Lighting & Atmosphere: Warm golden-hour backlighting, soft, glowing rays, gentle highlights on leaves, bark, and fabric. Feels calm, timeless and deeply restful.

Technical Details: Sharp focus on the man and main branch, soft depth of field, photorealistic textures, warm natural color grading, subtle film grain, no artificial CGI look.
prompts.description: Cinematic Nature Photography Prompt: Use this prompt to create a realistic golden hour portrait of a young man relaxing on a tree in a sunlit autumn forest.

prompts.title: The Golden Breath
prompts.prompt:
Create a highly detailed cinematic digital artwork of a woman meditating peacefully in a lush, sun-drenched forest environment. The scene should feel mystical, serene, and spiritually powerful, rendered with hyper-realistic lighting and cinematic depth.
Subject & Composition

A woman sits in a perfect Padmasana (Lotus position) at the centre of the frame. She occupies 25-35% of the canvas. Her eyes are closed, and her face shows deep calm and inner peace. Her hands rest gently on her knees in Gyan Mudra, with the thumb and index finger touching. Her posture is straight, balanced, and relaxed, conveying deep meditation.
She wears loose, breathable white meditation clothing made of linen or cotton, with natural folds and a soft, natural fabric texture. Subtle translucency appears along the edges where sunlight hits the cloth.
The woman sits on a cream carpet atop a large, ancient, moss-covered stone pedestal, naturally integrated into the forest floor. The stone surface is weathered and textured with thick green moss.
Lighting & Atmosphere

Brilliant sunlight filters through tall forest trees, creating strong backlighting and rim lighting around the subject’s hair and shoulders. Warm golden god rays pass through the leaves, illuminating the scene and creating a soft halo effect.
From the center of her chest or solar plexus, a powerful white-gold spiritual light radiates outward, acting as a secondary light source that illuminates her torso and the surrounding energy field.
The color palette blends deep forest greens, earthy browns, and moss textures, contrasted with glowing golden light and soft white tones from the subject and energy effects.
Energy Effects

Swirling Golden Filaments: Ribbons of glowing, golden light that loop gracefully outward, resembling an ethereal, abstract wave around the subject.

Central Radiance: A bright, star-like glow emanating directly from her solar plexus, illuminating her clothing and face.

Luminous Dust: Thousands of shimmering, magical light particles floating within the energy trails.
Depth of Field & Camera Style

The image uses a shallow depth of field, similar to a full-frame camera shot at f/1.8–f/2.8. Foreground leaves and distant trees are softly blurred with natural bokeh, drawing attention to the subject and glowing energy rings.
Rendering Style

Ultra-high-resolution hyper-realistic rendering with extremely detailed textures: moss on stone, tree bark, forest foliage, and individual strands of hair. The scene should resemble a cinematic 3D render image photographed with a professional DSLR camera and enhanced with subtle VFX.
Aspect ratio: 4:5
Quality: ultra detailed, cinematic lighting, 8K resolution

prompts.title: The Stone Circle
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image as a strict identity reference. Preserve the subject’s exact facial structure, proportions, skin tone, eye shape, nose, lips, jawline, and bone structure.
A serene, surreal scene of a young woman levitating in deep meditation above a calm lake at sunrise. She floats in a cross-legged lotus pose (Padmasana), hands resting on her knees in Gyan Mudra, eyes gently closed with a peaceful expression. She wears a loose, natural linen outfit in soft beige tones—a V-neck tunic and drawstring trousers—with slightly gathered at the waist, realistic fabric folds and texture. Her dark, shoulder-length wavy hair is partially braided at the temples, softly backlit by warm golden-hour light.
Large and small river stones levitate around her in a slow spiraling circle, defying gravity. The stones vary in size and texture—from rough granite boulders to smooth river rocks—with water droplets suspended mid-air, dripping from their undersides as if freshly lifted from the lake. Beneath her, concentric ripples spread across the glassy water surface, reflecting the stones and soft sky.
The environment is enveloped in misty morning fog, with faint silhouettes of distant trees along the shoreline. Lighting is warm, soft, and diffused, creating a gentle halo around the subject and subtle highlights on the floating rocks. The color palette is earthy and neutral—beiges, soft grays, muted greens, and warm gold—evoking tranquility, spiritual power, balance, and harmony with nature. Ultra-realistic, cinematic, surreal fantasy photography, shallow depth of field, high detail, ethereal atmosphere.
Keep Her and Stones in centre frame, centered composition, no cropping.
Aspect ratio 4:5.
